svg.title: CDN peering lifecycle from service registration through peering initiation, negotiation, resource discovery, operational management, and disband/re-arrangement

g.text: CDN peering lifecycle from service registration through peering initiation, negotiation, resource discovery, operational management, and disband/re-arrangement
Publish resource info and perform on-demand caching, content selection, and routing
Deliver content to end-users based on negotiated policies
Exchange policy, resource information, and service requirements with external PAs
Establish peering and enable PAs to cooperate on common goals
